author: Badwolf_TW
description: Add application vote reactions, require at least 16 leading approvals, let channel managers confirm approved applications, and expire reviews after one calendar month.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores application message IDs, channel IDs, and creation and expiration timestamps for up to one calendar month. It does not store message content or user data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing. Use `[p]applicationreview channel #channel` to set the application channel.
name: ApplicationReview
short: Vote on applications, confirm approval, and expire reviews after one month.
